name: DGCR8 microprocessor complex subunit

function.text: DGCR8 encodes microprocessor complex subunit DGCR8. Annotated molecular activities include protein homodimerization activity and protein-RNA adaptor activity. It participates in DNA damage response and primary miRNA processing.
